web_of_lies.about: Chain of truth-tellers and liars (BIG-Bench Hard web_of_lies format). One latent step per person.

boolean_expressions.about: Evaluate a not/and/or expression (BIG-Bench Hard boolean_expressions format). One latent step per operator, plus one.

task.question: Is the expression True or False?

navigate.about: Do the instructions return you to the start? (BIG-Bench Hard navigate format, without the Options block). One latent step per instruction, plus one.
